summary_en: This study tests bleximenib added to venetoclax and azacitidine, compared with placebo added to venetoclax and azacitidine, in newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia with a KMT2A rearrangement or NPM1 mutation. Bleximenib, venetoclax and placebo are taken by mouth, and azacitidine is given into a vein or under the skin, in 28-day cycles that continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa bleximenib añadido a venetoclax y azacitidina, comparado con placebo añadido a venetoclax y azacitidina, en leucemia mieloide aguda recién diagnosticada con una reordenación de KMT2A o una mutación de NPM1. Bleximenib, venetoclax y el placebo se toman por vía oral, y la azacitidina se administra por vena o debajo de la piel, en ciclos de 28 días que continúan hasta la progresión o una toxicidad inaceptable. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Newly diagnosed AML with a KMT2A rearrangement or NPM1 mutation, with at least 10% bone marrow blasts.
Not eligible for intensive chemotherapy because of age or health conditions, as judged by the care team.
Agrees to pregnancy and contraception rules and signs informed consent.
not_for: Known active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Recipient of a solid organ transplant.
Heart events within 6 months of randomization, such as heart attack or heart failure.
Active infectious hepatitis, or a live attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks of randomization.
